question: What is the true status of a knower in relation to the Lord's perception?
premises: In reality no knower exists apart from awareness.
Every knower has awareness as its lord.
Any valid position derives its operation from the Lord's perception.
inference: Therefore the knower's position is grounded in the Lord's perceptual awareness.
plain_english: In reality there is no one apart from awareness, for each knower has awareness as its lord; thus any position operates only as drawn from the Lord's perception.
